def.emiratization: UAE nationals as a share of all employees of ENEC, ENEC Operations and ENEC Commercial at year end.
def.emiratization_senior: UAE nationals as a share of employees in senior management positions.
def.top_positions_uae: Number of UAE nationals holding top positions, as published in the sustainability report.
def.women: Women as a share of all employees at year end.
def.employees: Total employees of the group at year end.
def.training_hours: Total hours of training delivered to employees in the year.
def.training_hours_per_employee: Training hours divided by the number of employees.
def.attrition: Employees who left as a share of employees. The published chart is hard to read, so the year mapping is uncertain.
def.hires: New employees hired in the year. Read from a chart; treat as approximate.
def.sro_ro: Senior Reactor Operators and Reactor Operators holding a FANR operator certificate, as stated in ENEC's GPO release.
def.coct_population: Licensed operators in the continuing operator training programme.
def.loct_population: Local operators in the local operator continuing training programme.
def.quals_renewed_on_time: Share of qualifications renewed before their expiry date in the quarter (demo tenant).
def.lapses: Number of licence validity lapses detected in the quarter (demo tenant).
def.jpm_to_signed_days: Average days between a JPM being performed and the record being signed (demo tenant).
def.equivalency_turnaround: Average days from a contractor equivalency request to the decision (demo tenant).
def.share_emirati: Emirati employees divided by headcount for the selected group and quarter.
def.share_women: Women divided by headcount for the selected group and quarter.
def.headcount: Employees on the last day of the quarter.
def.attrition_rate: Employees who left during the quarter.
def.hours_per_head: Training hours recorded in the quarter divided by headcount.
def.bench_depth: For each critical role: people qualified now, people in training, people in the pipeline, against a target set by HR. Counts only.
def.cohort_progress: Scholar and intern cohorts from intake to study, graduation and placement. Cohorts under the minimum group size are suppressed.
def.completions: Completed training records per course. Courses with fewer than the minimum group size are suppressed.
def.funnel: Applications currently at each stage, by programme. Cells under the minimum group size are suppressed.
def.handover_cover: Positions held by KHNP experts under the Operating Support Services Agreement (OSSA) or by contractors, per role and plan year. A SAMPLE plan for the demo tenant, sized to the roughly 400 KHNP experts a year the OSSA provides until 2030. After the OSSA end year the cover is zero.
def.handover_ready: ENEC people projected ready to take over a covered position by the end of the OSSA year: named successors on F19 succession slates (or, for roles without a slate, staff who shortlisted the role, with their F05 readiness) plus trainees in earmarked cohorts. Projected dates are SIMULATED from the F05/F06 estimate and programme lengths.
def.handover_pipeline: Trainees in COIT, LOIT, GPO, DNT and discipline cohorts earmarked to replace external cover (SAMPLE). For every critical role the earmarked trainees never exceed the role's in-training plus pipeline bench count.
def.handover_burndown: Per year: external cover, ready successors (cumulative) and the positions to hand over (the cover in the as-of year). A shortfall year is one where positions already handed over exceed ready successors. SIMULATED; what-if settings move the OSSA end and delay the pipeline.
def.handover_risk: Number of functions with a shortfall in any plan year. A count of functions, not of people.
def.handover_emirati: UAE nationals among the successors ready by the OSSA end, shown only when both the Emirati count and the total are at least 10. National direction (quality of Emiratisation), not a quota.
def.outlook_supply: People holding a skill family at Practitioner level or above (F01 skill states of active staff), scaled from the measured staff sample to the organisation headcount, then projected: minus general attrition and known retirements and contract ends (F20 KLRA, weighted by risk band), plus trainees ready from the pipeline (F22 cohorts, DNT intake) and reskilled staff. SIMULATED, people-equivalents.
def.outlook_demand: People whose role profile needs the skill family (M01 role competencies), scaled to the organisation, plus positions returning from KHNP OSSA and contractor cover as the handover plan steps down, times the chosen staffing scenario's growth and the ADVANCE adoption uplift (M11 adjustDemand). SIMULATED, people-equivalents.
def.outlook_gap: Demand minus supply for a skill family and year: positive is a shortfall, negative a surplus. Families with fewer than 10 measured holders or role holders are suppressed and never added into a total. SIMULATED: a planning aid, not a forecast.
def.outlook_tornado: Cumulative shortfall (people-years summed over the shown families from the base year to the horizon) with each assumption moved to the low and the high end of a fixed range while the others stay where they are. The longest bar changes the gap most. SIMULATED.
def.outlook_automation: Share of a skill family's demand that AI and automation could take at full adoption, from the FS06 task layer: partly automatable tasks count 50% of their effort, augmented tasks 20%, human-core tasks 0, each phased in over three years from its change horizon. The adoption assumption (0 to 100%) scales it; at 0 the outlook is unchanged. Task counts, not people. SIMULATED.
def.market_reference: A sourced external figure (a copy of an FS01 benchmark figure with its source and as-of date) drawn as a dashed line beside a number measured at ENEC (SIMULATED, solid bar). The two are compared only by position (above, below, level) and never added, averaged or netted. Figures the research packs flag as secondary or unverified are held back.

reconcile.title: Why do public figures differ?
reconcile.body: Press releases and the ENEC Operations CEO message say "around 60%" of about 3,000 staff are Emirati. Audited GRI data for the whole group gives 54.7% for 2024 (2,979 employees; 1,581 UAE nationals, which is 53.1%). Use the GRI figure when precision matters.

demand.b: Active staff whose role profile needs the skill family (M01 role competencies), times the chosen staffing scenario's growth from its start year.

handover.b: Positions held today by KHNP OSSA experts or contractors in roles that need the family come back to ENEC staff as the F22 cover plan steps down, all of them after the OSSA end year.

advance.b: The family's share of skills mapped to ADVANCE technologies times the M11 future-skills index (adjustDemand with the adoption factor), ramping up over five years from the start year.

supply.b: Active staff holding the family at Practitioner level or above in their F01 skill state, less general attrition each year.

klra.b: Retirements and contract ends within five years in F20 KLRA positions, spread over their band's years and weighted by risk band (high 1.0, medium 0.7, low 0.4).

pipeline.b: F22 cohorts earmarked for roles that need the family arrive at their ready year; DNT graduates join the Local Operator families from 2028.

reskill.b: Staff at awareness level in the family reach Practitioner at the reskilling rate each year (per family if set).

scale.b: The demo tenant's staff are a sample: counts are scaled to the organisation headcount (SAMPLE workforce snapshot) and shown as people-equivalents.

suppression.b: A family with fewer than {n} people measured (holders or role holders) returns only its name and "suppressed"; totals add up shown families only. Security is out of scope (career path only).

tornado.b: Each assumption is moved across a fixed plausible range with the others held; the bar shows how much the cumulative shortfall moves. Resetting the assumptions reproduces the baseline exactly.

automation.b: Each family's automation share comes from the FS06 task layer: tasks that need the family's skills and that AI can partly automate count half of their effort, tasks AI can augment a fifth, human-core tasks nothing; each task phases in over three years from its change horizon. Demand is multiplied by one minus adoption times that share. At adoption 0 the outlook is exactly the F35 one.

market.b: External figures are copies of sourced FS01 benchmark figures, drawn as dashed lines labelled "Market statistic" with their source and date. Numbers measured at ENEC are solid bars labelled SIMULATED. The two are only placed side by side, never added together; figures the research packs flag as secondary are held back.
